scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n be,fe -c blue,green "npm --workspace backend run dev" "npm --workspace frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace backend run dev
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace frontend run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace backend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace backend run typecheck && npm --workspace frontend run typecheck
